description: Lemlab, published by Technical University of Munich, provides agent-based simulation and real-time testing of local energy-market applications. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README states that lemlab is no longer actively developed and points to HAMLET as its successor. Earlier statements of ongoing development on the same page are historical. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
